title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Triage Agent summaries for DLP alerts in Microsoft Defender XDR
summary: Hold: the briefing treats doing nothing as guaranteeing no summaries, but Microsoft's notice says Defender XDR will display them when the agent is already deployed. The configuration paths, licensing and operational details are otherwise supported; the role-membership path needs its remaining steps and several checklist controls have no table row.

claims.quote: Data Security Triage Agent summaries and categorizations for DLP alerts will be made available in DLP Alerts in Microsoft Defender XDR.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters: first paragraph
claims.claim: The change is off by default and doing nothing guarantees no deployed agent and no summaries in Defender XDR.
claims.quote:
Who is affected: ... Organizations using Microsoft Purview Data Security Triage Agent
... DLP alerts in Defender XDR will display AI-generated summaries and categorizations when the Agent is deployed.
claims.fix: Set defaultState to "on" for this new display surface, qualified by deployment of the agent. Replace the first sentence of Why it matters with: "For tenants where the agent is already deployed, DLP alerts in Defender XDR will display its summaries and categorisations. Tenants without an agent must have an eligible admin or analyst deploy it first; agents are not deployed automatically." Cite MC1255406 and https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/security/security-copilot-inclusion. Do not equate taking no action on this change with having no existing agent.

claims.claim: The action rating review treats the change as doing nothing until someone chooses it.

DLP alerts in Defender XDR will display AI-generated summaries and categorizations when the Agent is deployed.
